verification.result: six HTTP 200 responses including the discarded warm-up

non_claims: This is one short coding prompt with five warm measured requests; it is a clean control, not a broad workload median or quality claim.
The 4.96 percent comparison is observational because the prior two samples were not interleaved and used lower expert residency.
Stopping the embedding replicas does not prove they caused prior variance; it proves the cleared configuration and measured result.
Strix was only probed read-only; no temporary move or shutdown was performed.
The Optane device remained absent from B550 lsblk/findmnt.
Repeated identical output within this control is not a cross-build correctness or acceptance gate.
